name: Shadcn DateTime Picker
summary: A datetime picker demo built on shadcn/ui, @daypicker/react v10 and Base UI, with 3 variants and 16+ features.
description: A fully-featured date and time picker built on shadcn/ui, @daypicker/react v10 and Base UI. The demo shows a calendar plus time picker in one popover, with a 12-hour format, 30-minute intervals, min/max dates, business hours (9 AM – 5 PM), a timezone selector, Monday week start, disabled weekends and a full booking scenario. Fully responsive.
